newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha easy but crude gains give support.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha easy but crude gains give support.

text.p: NWE spot and paper naphtha prices remained easy on Thursday. Traders said firmer afternoon crude provided some support but discussion was very thin as buyers stayed scarce, traders said.

Sellers of physical cargoes initially reduced offers amid poor demand and good supply, while paper markets extended Wednesday's losses in sympathy with weaker gasoline markets that came under further pressure in early trade.
Ample refinery supply in ARA pegged barge prices back to around $175-$176. Traders said there was little demand.
Cargo sellers eased offers a couple of dollars but a dearth of buying interest left the market notional around $178/$181 cif NWE.
After loosing ground on Wednesday with weaker gasoline markets swaps prices continued on the slide shedding $4-5 a tonne in early business with May contracts valued around $178.50 tonne cif NWE.
